name: cfcmt-bus-native-action-replay-v1

asset_selection.ordering: Original route, direction, pattern and service id, before any control outcomes
asset_selection.network: GTFS-derived route corridors; APC-apportioned demand, generated destinations; not a measured city road network
asset_selection.calendar_rule: Earliest weekday in the pinned GTFS feed with active weekday service and without a holiday exception; keep the original 12-service subset
asset_selection.calendar_provenance: Actual trip_id/service_id and full stop signatures from GTFS; never merge mutually exclusive calendar services or clamp zero scheduled headways

selection: Largest absolute projected executed holding difference along adapted55k native baseline before episode_seconds-minimum_remaining_seconds; exact tie uses earliest original event order. No ranking by Q, outcome, cost, or seed.

branches.adapted: Adapted baseline from reset to full horizon.
branches.single: Same adapted prefix through selected event; use masked action once, then recompute remaining same-time events and all future events with adapted.
branches.continuous: Same adapted prefix through selected event; use masked action at selected event and all remaining same-time/future events.

comparison: Each intervention compares full-horizon accrued passenger cost against the same baseline state and population. Entire prefix and checkpoint/asset identities are frozen, not SUMO-saveState or restored Python approximations.
counterfactual_checks: Exact replay of baseline pre-intervention event identities,times,executed actions; equality of selected raw/canonical state, prior within event batch, tracker and passenger ledger. Use deterministic seed/reset and zero optimizer updates.
code_boundary: CFCMT-owned frozen snapshot only; no mutable Thesis access. Remote code/smallJSON/log only, no H5/CSV/checkpoint downloads.
limits: One diagnostic seed/case/event selected by action divergence; not a general or statistically independent performance claim.
Continuous-branch effects combine first action and downstream decisions; single intervention is a controlled first-action effect conditional on adapted continuation.
Projected Q ranks are learned estimates; actual full-horizon passenger outcomes determine the observed effect.
The minimum remaining time120s equals2*maximum_hold60s; no episode outcome enters event selection.
